findings.title: Frontend "Taxable value" formula does not match the server's truncated margin
findings.location: design.md — Frontend → Totals shown on the page
findings.problem: The client computes holdingMargin = marketplace * (pct/100) with no rounding, but the server adds grossedMarketplace(base,pct) - base, where grossedMarketplace truncates base*(1+pct/100) to scale-2 with RoundingMode.DOWN. For the reference numbers the server margin is 1799.22 while the client formula gives 1799.226, so the client-rendered 'Taxable value' can show a different cent than the server-authoritative GST/Total/PDF. The design's own stated goal is that the page's taxable matches the server and PDF; this formula does not guarantee it and reintroduces the exact drift the single-rounding rule removed.
findings.fix: Mirror the server rounding on the client (const grossed = pct>0 ? Math.floor(marketplace*(1+pct/100)*100)/100 : marketplace; const holdingMargin = grossed - marketplace;) and use the same corrected margin for the read-only holding-cost summary line, OR expose the server-computed taxable/margin on InvoiceDto and render it directly instead of recomputing on the client. Pick one and state it.

findings.title: ROLE_BILLOPS_ADMIN_SUB silently excluded from the endpoint
findings.problem: Method security is enabled and the chosen roles match the private-pricing endpoints (consistent, not a regression). But SecurityConfig grants the admin dashboard to ROLE_BILLOPS_ADMIN_SUB too; a SUB admin can open the detail page, see the control (UI gates on draft+marketplace, not role), and get a 403. Not stated in the design.
findings.fix: Add a sentence: SUB admins are intentionally excluded (matching private pricing) and the UI must hide/disable the control for users lacking ROLE_BILLOPS_ADMIN/ROLE_SUPER_ADMIN; or add ROLE_BILLOPS_ADMIN_SUB to the authority list if SUB admins should use it.

findings.title: Base-USD printed via doubleValue()+%.2f is a lossy round-trip
findings.problem: Converting BigDecimal(19,4) to double before %.2f can mis-render the last cent for edge values. This is the existing pattern the design extends and the reference case renders correctly, so it is not a blocker.
findings.fix: Keep the existing doubleValue() form on the zero branch for byte-identical backward compat; note that pinned rendering tests cover the reference values. No required change.
